summary_of_changes: Replaced all manual paper submissions with digital portal entries, introduced automated credential generation, metadata validation, Aadhaar/bank verification, and eligibility engine. Consolidated verification steps, eliminated duplicate handoffs, and retained human approvals for registration, exception handling, eligibility confirmation, and financial disbursement decisions.
